verdict.rationale: Cal.com's AI-native story is that it exposes its own scheduling tools TO AI agents (via API v2 and the hosted MCP server at mcp.cal.com), not that Cal.com itself acts as an MCP client host that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools. All evidence describes Cal.com as the MCP server/tool provider, none shows it consuming other MCP servers, so this client-side axis is a category mismatch for a scheduling SaaS product.
